name: neon-text
title: NeonText
description: A glowing neon sign with a rare, gentle flicker.

accessibility: The flicker is two short dips every 7 seconds, far below 3 flashes per second; turn it off with `flicker={false}`.
Use it on a dark surface and check contrast of the pale letters, not the glow.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the glow steady.
